outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain schematic plus representative western blots used to evaluate antibody IP efficiency (single FT/E blot images per antibody). No quantification, averaging, error bars, or statistics are shown, so no replicate reporting is required.

Panel B is a quantitative bar chart of densitometry values (% HTT FT depletion vs mIgG; log2 elution abundance vs mIgG) for each antibody. No error bars, individual data points, or n-number/replicate type (e.g., number of blots/experiments quantified) are given in the caption or on the plot.

replicate_statements: expressed as the log2 average of two biological replicates in Q20 and Q140-8 weeks conditions
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states n and type (two biological replicates), but the heatmap displays averaged (summary) values derived from only n = 2 replicates, which is too low to support the summary statistic shown.

Violin plots show distributions of log2 enrichment ratios per antibody/genotype, a quantitative summary requiring replicate disclosure, but the caption for panel D does not state how many biological/technical replicates underlie each ratio or what type of replicate was used.

An n-number (n = 4) and summary statistic (mean ± SD) are given, but the caption never explicitly identifies what the n represents (e.g., mice, independent IPs, biological replicates); it is only loosely inferable from the surrounding sentence about mice.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a single predicted (AlphaFold) structural model, a non-replicated schematic/model illustration with no quantification, so replicate reporting is not applicable.

Scatterplots compare log2 fold-change enrichment values (themselves derived from averaged replicate IP-MS measurements) between Q20 and Q140 for different antibody sets, but the caption does not state the number or type of replicates underlying these values.

The panel reports a correlation statistic (R²) across individual IP-MS experiments by tissue, but the caption does not state how many individual experiments/replicates (points) went into this correlation or what type they represent.

The PCA plot displays clusters of individual sample points stratified by antibody set and tissue, implying multiple replicate samples per group, but the caption does not state the number of samples/replicates or their type (e.g., animals, independent IPs).

As in panel I, this PCA plot shows clustered individual sample points per antibody set, polyQ length, and tissue, but no n-number or replicate type is stated in the caption for these underlying samples.
